About the Company:
Multiz Corp Pty Ltd provides innovative point-of-sale and online ordering systems through the QonUS platform. We deliver advanced software solutions tailored for restaurants and retail businesses across Australia.
About the Role:
We are seeking a qualified and experienced
Software Engineer
to join our growing development team. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable applications that support the QonUS ecosystem.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain software applications (Flutter, Node.js, C#, .NET, Kotlin, MongoDB).
Integrate APIs, payment gateways, and third-party services.
Ensure high performance, reliability, and security across all software components.
Work with cross-functional teams to deliver system updates and new features.
Maintain technical documentation and participate in code reviews.
Provide technical support and troubleshooting as required.
Skills and Experience Required:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
At least 2 years of relevant industry experience.
Strong knowledge of modern programming languages (Dart/Flutter, Java/Kotlin, C#, JavaScript/Node.js).
Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, Kubernetes, Docker).
Database management experience (MongoDB, SQL).
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
Desirable:
Experience with POS or payment system integration.
Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and container registries.
Position Title: Software Engineer
Employer: Multiz Corp Pty Ltd (QonUS Platform)
Location: Chatswood, NSW 2067
Employment Type: Full-time, ongoing
Salary: AUD $80,000 – $85,000 per annum (exclusive of superannuation)
Hours: 38 hours per week
Application Process:
Please send your CV and cover letter to:
admin@qonus.com.au
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
